## EMCargo v1.30.0

This release hardens the boundaries around dangerous-goods compliance, authentication, imports and production builds.

### Highlights

- Standardises the air-freight compliance profile on `IATA_DGR`, retains the legacy `IATA` alias and makes a missing Q calculation explicitly visible instead of looking approved.
- Invalidates existing sessions after a password change, secures login cookies for HTTPS and trusted reverse proxies, restricts roles and protects the last active administrator.
- Limits uploads and remap payloads, including row, column, cell and decompressed-XLSX limits.
- Moves the frontend to React 19.2.8 and React Router 8.3.0, separates runtime from test dependencies and adds blocking production dependency audits.
- Builds pull-request Docker images for AMD64 and ARM64 without publishing them.
- Cleans interrupted PDF, ZIP, XLSX and temporary exports safely at startup.

The release was validated with backend and frontend tests, TypeScript/Vite build, `pip check`, version consistency, production `npm audit` and the multi-architecture Docker build.
